project_name.justification: The article is titled 'Ramp Metals Completes Drill Program and Acquires 100% Ownership in Rottenstone SW and PLD Properties'.

company_name.justification: Ramp Metals Inc. (TSXV: RAMP) ("Ramp Metals " or the "Company") is pleased to announce that the Company has successfully completed a 2024 drill program at its Rottenstone SW project...

ceo_buyer.justification: "We are pleased to share that our recent drill program has concluded successfully, with assays currently pending," commented Jordan Black, CEO of Ramp Metals.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: Ramp Metals Inc. ... acquired a 100% interest in both the Rottenstone SW and PLD property pursuant to the Company's option agreement with Rottenstone Resources Ltd. dated March 16, 2022.

primary_commodity.justification: The Rottenstone SW property is located along a regional NE-SW structure from the historic Rottenstone Mine, which produced 40,000 tons of high grade nickel-copper-platinum group elements plus gold (Ni-Cu-PGE + Au) ore...

verified_article_link.justification: The article is titled 'Ramp Metals Completes Drill Program and Acquires 100% Ownership in Rottenstone SW and PLD Properties', which directly relates to the project of interest.

currency.justification: The company is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV: RAMP) and a future payment is denominated in '$', implying Canadian Dollars. 'The Company has the ability to purchase 1/2 of the royalty (1%) at any time for $1,000,000.'

cash_payments_raw.justification: The article announces the completion of a prior option agreement but does not state the cash consideration paid to complete the acquisition.

share_payments_raw.justification: The article announces the completion of a prior option agreement but does not state any share consideration paid to complete the acquisition.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The article announces the completion of a prior option agreement but does not state the combined value of the consideration paid to complete the acquisition.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The article does not mention any shares being issued as part of the acquisition completion.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants were mentioned as part of the transaction.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned as part of the transaction consideration.

issued_share_price.justification: No shares were issued as part of the transaction, so there is no issue price.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The article mentions a completed drill program of 1180m, but this is a past action, not a future commitment required by the acquisition.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The article does not state any future exploration spending commitment as part of the acquisition.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The acquisition is 'subject only to a 2% net smelter royalty.' This royalty was retained by the seller.

coverage_area_raw.justification: The Rottenstone SW property... consists of 12 mineral deposit claims covering approximately 17,285 hectares.

coverage_area_unit.justification: The Rottenstone SW property... consists of 12 mineral deposit claims covering approximately 17,285 hectares.

resource_size.justification: The article does not contain a mineral resource estimate for the Rottenstone SW project. It mentions historical production from a nearby mine and sample grades, but not a compliant resource statement.
